mine.rules_body:
Minesweeper is a game about a smiley.

At the top you see the smiley. You have 10 flags,
and you must place exactly 10 flags in the cells.

Place more and you go into minus, and we do not
want to go into minus. It has to come out even.

The remaining cells are filled with question marks.
This has to be done against the clock.

I have not fully worked out these rules yet.
